42752-tempest-driven-a-romance-vol-3-of-.title: A Romance.
42752-tempest-driven-a-romance-vol-3-of-.creator: Unknown
42752-tempest-driven-a-romance-vol-3-of-.description: A public-domain book from Project Gutenberg. That day, when the two girls left the back room, they went straight to Madge's, where they talked over the arrival of Jerry O'Brien, for whom Edith strongly suspected Madge had a warmer feeling than friendship, and who, she felt morally certain, greatly to her secret delight, was over head and ears in love with Madge. The only human being in whom she had infinite faith was Madge. She did not consider any hero or conqueror of history good enough for her sister.

arxiv-1905-11380.title: On Star-critical ( K 1 , n , K 1 , m + e ) (K_{1,n},K_{1,m}+e) Ramsey numbers
arxiv-1905-11380.creator: C. J. Jayawardene
arxiv-1905-11380.description: Abstract We say that K n → ( G , H ) K_{n}\rightarrow(G,H) , if for every red/blue coloring of edges of the complete graph K n K_{n} , there exists a red copy of G G , or a blue copy of H H in the coloring of K n K_{n} .

arxiv-2005-04333.title: Monopoles And Landau-Ginzburg Models II: Floer Homology
arxiv-2005-04333.creator: Donghao Wang
arxiv-2005-04333.description: Abstract . This is the second paper in this series. Following the setup of Meng-Taubes, we define the monopole Floer homology for any pair ( Y , ω ) (Y,\omega) , where Y Y is a compact oriented 3-manifold with toroidal boundary and ω \omega is a suitable closed 2-form viewed as a decoration.

arxiv-2205-12923.title: Domain Adaptation for Object Detection using SE Adaptors and Center Loss
arxiv-2205-12923.creator: Sushruth Nagesh*, Shreyas Rajesh*, Asfiya Baig*, Savitha Srinivasan*
arxiv-2205-12923.description: A 2022 arXiv research paper by Sushruth Nagesh*, Shreyas Rajesh*, Asfiya Baig*, Savitha Srinivasan*. Despite growing interest in object detection, very few works address the extremely practical problem of cross-domain robustness especially for automative applications. In order to prevent drops in performance due to domain shift, we introduce an unsupervised domain adaptation method built on the foundation of faster-RCNN with two domain adaptation components addressing the shift at the instance and image levels respectively and apply a consistency regularization between them.

arxiv-2206-07089.title: A Collaboration Strategy in the Mining Pool for Proof-of-Neural-Architecture Consensus Journal: Blockchain: Research and Applications
arxiv-2206-07089.creator: Boyang Li, Qing Lu, Weiwen Jiang, Taeho Jung, Yiyu Shi
arxiv-2206-07089.description: A 2022 arXiv research paper by Boyang Li, Qing Lu, Weiwen Jiang, Taeho Jung, Yiyu Shi. In most popular public accessible cryptocurrency systems, the mining pool plays a key role because mining cryptocurrency with the mining pool turns the non-profitable situation into profitable for individual miners. In many recent novel blockchain consensuses, the deep learning training procedure becomes the task for miners to prove their workload, thus the computation power of miners will not purely be spent on the hash puzzle.

arxiv-2301-00118.title: Airborne Ultrasound Focusing Aperture with Binary Amplitude Mask Over Planar Ultrasound Emissions
arxiv-2301-00118.creator: Masatake Kitano, Keisuke Hasegawa
arxiv-2301-00118.description: Abstract Phased arrays of airborne ultrasound transducers are widely utilized as a key technology to achieve mid-air convergence of intense ultrasound, which is applied to a variety of systems, such as contactless tactile presentation, acoustic-levitation and its application, mid-air-flow acceleration, etc.

arxiv-2307-02965.title: Correlating space, wavelength, and polarization of light: Spatio-Spectral Vector Beams
arxiv-2307-02965.creator: Lea Kopf, 1 Rafael Barros, 1 and Robert Fickler 1 1 Tampere University, Photonics Laboratory, Physics Unit, Tampere, FI-33720, Finland
arxiv-2307-02965.description: Abstract Increasing the complexity of a light field through the advanced manipulation of its degrees of freedom (DoF) provides new opportunities for fundamental studies and technologies. Correlating polarization with the light’s spatial or spectral shape results in so-called spatial or spectral vector beams that are fully polarized and have a spatially or spectrally varying polarization structure.

arxiv-2402-16319.title: Data-free Weight Compress and Denoise for Large Language Models
arxiv-2402-16319.creator: Runyu Peng, Yunhua Zhou, Qipeng Guo, Yang Gao, Hang Yan, Xipeng Qiu, Dahua Lin
arxiv-2402-16319.description: Abstract Large Language Models (LLMs) are reshaping the research landscape in artificial intelligence, particularly as model parameters scale up significantly, unlocking remarkable capabilities across various domains. Nevertheless, the scalability of model parameters faces constraints due to limitations in GPU memory and computational speed. To address these constraints, various weight compression methods have emerged, such as Pruning and Quantization.

arxiv-2406-15307.title: The Sensitivity of DUNE in Presence of Off-Diagonal Scalar NSI Parameters
arxiv-2406-15307.creator: Arnab Sarker, Dharitree Bezboruah, Abinash Medhi, Moon Moon Devi
arxiv-2406-15307.description: Abstract Scalar non-standard interactions (NSI) presents an exciting pathway for probing potential new physics that extends beyond the Standard Model (BSM). The scalar coupling of neutrinos with matter can appear as a sub-dominant effect that can impact the neutrino oscillation probabilities. The uniqueness of these interactions is that it can directly affect the neutrino mass matrix.

arxiv-2410-17762.title: Anomaly Resilient Temporal QoS Prediction using Hypergraph Convoluted Transformer Network
arxiv-2410-17762.creator: Suraj Kumar, Soumi Chattopadhyay, Chandranath Adak
arxiv-2410-17762.description: Abstract Quality-of-Service (QoS) prediction is a critical task in the service lifecycle, enabling precise and adaptive service recommendations by anticipating performance variations over time in response to evolving network uncertainties and user preferences. However, contemporary QoS prediction methods frequently encounter data sparsity and cold-start issues, which hinder accurate QoS predictions and limit the ability to capture diverse user preferences.

arxiv-2501-05700.title: Linguistic Entity Masking to Improve Cross-Lingual Representation of Multilingual Language Models for Low-Resource Languages
arxiv-2501-05700.creator: Aloka Fernando, Surangika Ranathunga
arxiv-2501-05700.description: Abstract Multilingual Pre-trained Language models (multiPLMs), trained on the Masked Language Modelling (MLM) objective are commonly being used for cross-lingual tasks such as bitext mining. However, the performance of these models is still suboptimal for low-resource languages (LRLs). To improve the language representation of a given multiPLM, it is possible to further pre-train it. This is known as continual pre-training.

arxiv-2503-16452.title: Towards Biomarker Discovery for Early Cerebral Palsy Detection: Evaluating Explanations Through Kinematic Perturbations
arxiv-2503-16452.creator: Kimji N. Pellano, Inga Strümke, Daniel Groos, Lars Adde, Pål Haugen, Espen Alexander F. Ihlen
arxiv-2503-16452.description: Abstract Cerebral Palsy (CP) is a prevalent motor disability in children, for which early detection can significantly improve treatment outcomes. While skeleton-based Graph Convolutional Network (GCN) models have shown promise in automatically predicting CP risk from infant videos, their “black-box” nature raises concerns about clinical explainability.

arxiv-2509-11341.title: Convective Space-Time Chaos as a Dynamical Model of Deterministic and Stochastic Turbulence
arxiv-2509-11341.creator: Arkady Pikovsky
arxiv-2509-11341.description: Abstract Recently, a concept of deterministic and stochastic turbulence has been introduced based on experiments with a boundary layer. A deterministic property means that identical random perturbations at the inlet lead to identical patterns downstream; during this stage, the non-identical, stochastic component grows and eventually dominates the flow further downstream.

pmc-12617123.title: PA20226. Ergonomic assessment of work activities that pose a risk of occupational diseases
pmc-12617123.creator: W Czernecka, M Butlewski, R Mierzwiak
pmc-12617123.description: PurposeThe aim of this abstract is to present an approach to ergonomic analyses at workstations where there is a risk of occupational disease, with particular attention paid to undertaking such activities in the context of corporate social responsibility and sustainable development of the organization.

pmc-12718455.title: Epigenetic crosstalk between uric acid and vascular health: a role for extracellular vesicles
pmc-12718455.creator: Concetta Schiano, Claudio Napoli
pmc-12718455.description: pregulation of DNMT3A and concomitant downregulation of DNMT3B and HDAC3/7 reported in individuals with elevated uric acid (UA) levels or undergoing premature coronary angiography (CPCA) is particularly interesting. These findings indicate that early epigenetic remodeling can occur independently of traditional cardiovascular risk factors. Extracellular vesicles (EVs) may play a central role in mediating the UA-associated epigenetic alterations described [2].

pmc-13112951.title: A Sequential Generalized Nonparametric Classification Method for Small-Scale Cognitive Diagnostic Assessment
pmc-13112951.creator: Junjie Li, Huijing Zheng, Chunhua Kang, Yan Cai, Dongbo Tu
pmc-13112951.description: Small-scale (e.g., classroom) assessment represents the most common and needed scenario for cognitive diagnostic testing. In such settings, polytomously scored items (e.g., constructed-response tasks) are widely used, as they provide more fine-grained measurement of students’ skills and cognitive processes. However, a significant gap remains between the current methods and pressing practical needs.

pmc-13243783.title: Family physician deployment in South Africa’s district health system: A cross-sectional study
pmc-13243783.creator: Theresia A. Rubler, Klaus B. von Pressentin, Robert J. Mash
pmc-13243783.description: BackgroundFamily physicians (FP) strengthen the quality of district health services. The South African Academy of Family Physicians (SAAFP) recommended that, by 2030, there be one FP per district hospital, community health centre or subdistrict without a community health centre. This study aimed to evaluate progress towards achieving the SAAFP’s goals.

pmc-13374423.title: Association between GLP-1-based therapy and small-bowel transit time during capsule endoscopy: a prospective, multicentre, observational study
pmc-13374423.creator: Fadi Abu Baker, Melhem Melhem, Osnat Kalnizki, Majd Khader, Michal Dardik, Mifleh Tatour, Rawi Hazzan
pmc-13374423.description: ObjectiveTo evaluate the association between glucagon-like peptide-1 (GLP-1) based therapy and small-bowel transit time during capsule endoscopy.MethodsWe conducted a prospective, multicentre, observational study of consecutive adults undergoing small-bowel capsule endoscopy for standard clinical indications. Patients receiving GLP-1-based therapy, defined as treatment with a GLP-1 receptor agonist or dual glucose-dependent insulinotropic polypeptide/GLP-1 receptor agonist, were compared with non-exposed controls.

uslaw-usc-t20-s3426.title: 20 U.S.C. § 3426 — Liaison for Proprietary Institutions of Higher Education
uslaw-usc-t20-s3426.creator: United States Congress
uslaw-usc-t20-s3426.description: United States Code, Title 20 (Education); Chapter 48 (Department Of Education); Subchapter II (Establishment Of The Department). Current through Public Law 119-134, as published by the Office of the Law Revision Counsel. (a) Establishment There shall be in the Department a Liaison for Proprietary Institutions of Higher Education, who shall be an officer of the Department appointed by the Secretary. (b) Appointment The Secretary shall appoint, not later than 6 months after.
